articles.summary: Aeria Management Group, which manages Bankstown and Camden airports in Sydney, prepared its FY26 emissions inventory with the Data Transformation Agent and cut the time it takes by at least half.
articles.title: How Aeria Management Group cut its emissions inventory time in half

articles.summary: IXOM, with around 1,300 staff in more than 50 locations, brought its emissions data into one place and has processed 679 files through the Data Transformation Agent, with source evidence kept on file for ASRS assurance.
articles.title: How IXOM centralised its emissions data ahead of ASRS assurance
